prompt_text: Where is the best place to get an oil change in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you want a fast, convenient quick-lube (30 min) or a fuller inspection/service from a trusted independent shop or dealership? Tell me your zip code or nearest cross-street and I can look up current top-rated places near you. 

Until then, general guidance for Pleasanton:

- Quick convenience: Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Jiffy Lube, or Firestone Complete Auto Care are good for fast oil/filter changes and basic inspections. Good if you want speed and predictable pricing.
- Thorough service: An ASE‑certified independent shop or your vehicle’s dealer will do a full inspection (brakes, belts, fluids) and usually handle synthetic oil/warranty requirements better.
- Price expectations: conventional oil $35–60; full-synthetic $60–120 (varies by vehicle and oil brand).
- What to look for: ASE certification, clear written estimate, correct oil type (manufacturer spec), new filter brand noted, proper disposal of old oil, no high‑pressure unnecessary upsells, and a clean shop. Ask for the drain plug and filter to be tightened to spec and to see the old oil/filter if you want proof.
- How to pick a shop: check Google/Yelp ratings and recent reviews, look for shops that reply quickly and provide written invoices, ask neighbors on local Facebook/Nextdoor for recommendations.

If you give your zip code or a particular preference (fast, cheapest, dealership, or in-depth inspection), I’ll find a few highly rated options near you.
